An Unconscious messenger must complete a Short Rest or Long Rest while attached to a warforged, after which it regains its energy, as well as regaining all lost Hit Points.

An {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} messenger must complete a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} while attached to a warforged, after which it regains its energy, as well as regaining all lost {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

actions.name: Dash
actions.descriptionHtml: The messenger gains extra movement equal to its Speed.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

entries: {@note Requires Use by a {@race Warforged|EFA}}

A delicate winged creature, this homunculus was designed to facilitate communication between warforged soldiers during the Last War. A {@item Final Messenger|ExploringEberron24} is a Tiny Construct with an AC of 20, 6 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet. It has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage and Psychic damage, and all conditions other than {@condition Unconscious|XPHB|Unconsciousness}. If it is forced to make an ability check or a saving throw, treat all its ability scores as 10 (+0). It has {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet. It has no limbs and the only action it can take on its turn is the {@action Dash|XPHB} action.

If you are a warforged, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to integrate a Final Messenger into your body. While it is part of your body, the messenger cannot be targeted by any attack. You can only have one messenger attached to your body at a time. A messenger can only remain active for 8 hours after it detaches from a warforged body, after which time its energy dissipates and it gains the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition. An {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} messenger must complete a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} while attached to a warforged, after which it regains its energy, as well as regaining all lost {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

A Final Messenger holds four pieces of data, accessible only to the warforged it is attached to. While the messenger is attached to you, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to review the data currently stored within the messenger, and if you choose to, change any or all of these data points.

items: A destination for the messenger. This can be very specific (a particular apartment in Sharn) or more general (an open marketplace).
A target individual. This could be a specific person or a category ("Any Karrnathi warforged").
A single image recorded through the eyes of a warforged attached to the messenger.
A message of up to 25 words.

entries: You can release the messenger as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, at which point it flies to its destination by the most direct route possible. Once it reaches the destination it seeks the target individual; if no target has been set, it approaches the nearest warforged.

If you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} while a Final Messenger is attached to you, it immediately detaches and seeks out its target. It retains its stored message, but replaces its stored image with the last thing you saw before dropping to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

traits.name: Stolen Gifts
traits.descriptionHtml:
At the start of each of his turns, the Forgotten Prince causes one creature he can see within 60 feet to make a DC 25 Wisdom (Perception) check. On a failed check, the Forgotten Prince steals one of the following from the target until the start of the his next turn:

  • Weapon Skill.

    For the duration, the target has Disadvantage on weapon attacks, and the Prince has Advantage on Dark Scythe attacks.

  • Spellcasting Ability.

    For the duration, the target has Disadvantage on spell attacks, and all creatures have Advantage on saving throws made to resist the target's spells. Additionally, all creatures have Disadvantage on saving throws to resist the Prince's spells.

  • Speed.

    The target's Speed is reduced by 20 feet (to a minimum of 5 feet). Additionally, the Prince's Speed is increased by 20 feet, and he can take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action.

actions.name: Summon Swarms
actions.descriptionHtml:
Valaara summons a swarm of insects or arachnids that fills a 10-foot-radius Sphere [Area of Effect] centered on a point Valaara can see within 120 feet, afflicting all creatures in the area with one of the following effects (roll a 1d6 or choose one), to which Valaara is immune:

  • Stinging Wasps.

    con DC 22. {@actSaveFail} 32 (5d12) Piercing damage, and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage and the target doesn't have Disadvantage on attack rolls.

  • Spinning Spiders.

    dex DC 22. {@actSaveFail} 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability to Fire damage; Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage).

  • Venomous Centipedes.

    con DC 22. {@actSaveFail} 22 (4d10) Poison damage and the target has the Poisoned condition. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

  • Infesting Grubs.

    dex DC 22. {@actSaveFail} The target is infested by 4 (1d4 + 2) rot grubs, taking 3 (1d6) Piercing damage per rot grub at the start of each of its turns. If a target infested with rot grubs ends its turn with 0 Hit Points, the rot grubs burrow into its heart, killing it. Any effect that cures disease kills all rot grubs infesting the target, ending the effect. Applying fire to the bite wound before the end of the creature's next turn deals 1 Fire damage to the creature and kills the rot grubs, ending the effect. After this time, the rot grubs are too far under the skin to be burned.

  • Discordant Cicadas.

    wis DC 22. {@actSaveFail} The target has the Frightened condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While Frightened, the target has the Incapacitated condition. {@actSaveSuccess} The target has Advantage on future saves against this swarm for 24 hours.
